stem: What is the primary function of NetFlow in network management and monitoring?

options.text: To encrypt data packets to ensure secure communication over the network.
To capture and store detailed payload data of every packet for deep packet inspection.
To collect and analyze IP traffic statistics for understanding network traffic patterns.
To block malicious network traffic and prevent unauthorized access to network resources.

stem: What is the primary purpose of the Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) in the context of cybersecurity?

options.text: To automate the generation of security policies and procedures.
To facilitate communication between vulnerability scanners and other security and management tools.
To encrypt sensitive security data and content.
To provide real-time monitoring of network traffic for security threats.
